summary: Abetment of suicide conviction under IPC s.306; evidence of harassment solely based on money demands for business; no demonstration of incessant cruelty leading to suicide; presumption s.113A Indian Evidence Act unapplicable; Geo Varghese (2021) and S.S. Cheena (2010) cited on required mens rea; High Court error in affirming conviction; conviction set aside for insufficient evidence.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellant acquitted of charges under Section 306 IPC.
